text_en: How the Lord in his anger has humiliated daughter Zion! He has thrown down from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel; he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
text_cn: 怎么！上主竟然发怒，使熙雍女郎暗淡无光！将以色列的荣华由高天抛在地上！在他震怒之日，不再想念自己的脚凳！

text_en: The Lord has destroyed without mercy all the dwellings of Jacob; in his wrath he has broken down the strongholds of daughter Judah; he has brought down to the ground in dishonor the kingdom and its rulers.
text_cn: 上主毫不留情地破坏了雅各伯所有的牧场；他满含怒气，夷平了犹大女郎的一切堡垒；将她的君王及首长推倒在地，加以侮辱。

text_en: He has cut down in fierce anger all the might of Israel; he has withdrawn his right hand from them in the face of the enemy; he has burned like a flaming fire in Jacob, consuming all around.
text_cn: 他怒火炎炎，粉碎了以色列的一切势力；在仇人前，抽回他的右手；他像吞灭四周的烈火，焚烧了雅各伯；

text_en: He has bent his bow like an enemy, with his right hand set like a foe; he has killed all in whom we took pride in the tent of daughter Zion; he has poured out his fury like fire.
text_cn: 他像敌人一样，安稳地举起自己的右手，拉开他的弓。像敌人似的，屠杀了一切英俊的少年；在熙雍女郎的帐幕内，发泄了他似火的烈怒。

text_en: The Lord has become like an enemy; he has destroyed Israel. He has destroyed all its palaces, laid in ruins its strongholds, and multiplied in daughter Judah mourning and lamentation.
text_cn: 上主好像一个仇人，毁灭了以色列，毁灭了她所有的宫室，荡平了她的一切堡垒，增加犹大女郎的哀号哭泣。

text_en: He has broken down his booth like a garden, he has destroyed his tabernacle; the Lord has abolished in Zion festival and sabbath, and in his fierce indignation has spurned king and priest.
text_cn: 上主像破坏园圃（pǔ）一样，破坏了他自己的帷幔，毁灭了自己的会幕，使人在熙雍忘却庆节和安息日；他在烈怒下，废弃了君王和司祭。

text_en: The Lord has scorned his altar, disowned his sanctuary; he has delivered into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; a clamor was raised in the house of the Lord as on a day of festival.
text_cn: 上主厌弃了自己的祭坛，嫌恶了自己的圣所；将宫殿的墙垣交在敌人手中，让他们在上主的殿宇内，叫嚣喧嚷，好像节日一样。

text_en: The Lord determined to lay in ruins the wall of daughter Zion; he stretched the line; he did not withhold his hand from destroying; he caused rampart and wall to lament; they languish together.
text_cn: 上主已经决意毁坏熙雍女郎的墙垣，既展开了绳索，决不抽回自己的手，直到将它完全推翻，使城郭和堡垒哀哭，一同倾覆。

text_en: Her gates have sunk into the ground; he has ruined and broken her bars; her king and princes are among the nations; guidance is no more, and her prophets obtain no vision from the Lord .
text_cn: 城门已陷于地中，上主已折断她的门闩，她的君王首长，流落异乡，再没有法律； 她的众先知也不再获得上主的神视。

text_en: The elders of daughter Zion sit on the ground in silence; they have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth; the young girls of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
text_cn: 熙雍女郎的众长老，坐在地上默然不语，头上撒上灰土，腰间束着麻衣；耶路撒冷的处女都俯首至地。

text_en: My eyes are spent with weeping; my stomach churns; my bile is poured out on the ground because of the destruction of my people, because infants and babes faint in the streets of the city.
text_cn: 我的眼痛哭，至于失明，五内沸腾，肝脑涂地。眼见我的女儿——人民遭受摧残，眼看着幼童乳儿昏厥（jué）在城中的街道上。

text_en: They cry to their mothers, “Where is bread and wine? ” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their life is poured out on their mothers’ bosom.
text_cn: 他们对母亲说：“那里有饼有酒？”他们在城中的街道上，正奄奄一息，有如受伤的人，在母亲的怀中，气绝夭折！

text_en: What can I say for you, to what compare you, O daughter Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter Zion? For vast as the sea is your ruin; who can heal you?
text_cn: 耶路撒冷女郎！我可用什么来譬喻你，拿什么来比拟你呢？处女，熙雍女郎！我可用什么来帮助你，拿什么来安慰你呢？因为你的创伤，浩大如海，又有谁能够治愈你？

text_en: Your prophets have seen for you false and deceptive visions; they have not exposed your iniquity to restore your fortunes, but have seen oracles for you that are false and misleading.
text_cn: 你的众先知有关你的神视，尽是虚幻欺诈；他们从未揭露你的罪恶，以挽回你的命运；他们关于你所提供的神谕，尽是虚幻和骗局。

text_en: All who pass along the way clap their hands at you; they hiss and wag their heads at daughter Jerusalem; “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth? ”
text_cn: 所有过路的人，都向你鼓掌，向耶路撒冷女郎嘘唏，且摇头说：“难道这就是人人所说美丽无比，全世界的喜悦？”

text_en: All your enemies open their mouths against you; they hiss, they gnash their teeth, they cry: “We have devoured her! Ah, this is the day we longed for; at last we have seen it! ”
text_cn: 你的仇人都向你张开口，嘘唏而切齿说：“我们终于吞灭了她！这就是我们所期待的一日，我们终于得到手，终于看见了！”

text_en: The Lord has done what he purposed, he has carried out his threat; as he ordained long ago, he has demolished without pity; he has made the enemy rejoice over you, and exalted the might of your foes.
text_cn: 上主实践了自己的计划，完成了他昔日所宣告的断语；实行破坏，毫无怜悯，使仇人幸灾乐祸，使敌人高举他的角。

text_en: Cry aloud to the Lord! O wall of daughter Zion! Let tears stream down like a torrent day and night! Give yourself no rest, your eyes no respite!
text_cn: 处女，熙雍女郎！你应该从心里呼号上主；白天黑夜，让眼泪像江河般地涌流，不要歇息，也不要让你的眼睛休息。

text_en: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the presence of the Lord! Lift your hands to him for the lives of your children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.
text_cn: 夜间每到交更时分，你该起来哀祷，像倾水似的，向上主倾诉你心；应为了你婴儿的性命，向上主举起你的双手，因为他们因饥饿而昏迷街头！

text_en: Look, O Lord , and consider! To whom have you done this? Should women eat their offspring, the children they have borne? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
text_cn: 上主，请你回目怜视！你这样做，究竟是对付谁呢？难道妇女应该吃掉自己的儿子？吃掉自己孕育的婴儿？ 难道在上主的圣所里，应该杀死司祭和先知？

text_en: The young and the old are lying on the ground in the streets; my young women and my young men have fallen by the sword; in the day of your anger you have killed them, slaughtering without mercy.
text_cn: 街上遍地躺卧的，尽是孩童和老人；丧身刀下的，尽是我的处女和少年；在你震怒之日，你斩杀诛戮（lù），毫不留情。

text_en: You invited my enemies from all around as if for a day of festival; and on the day of the anger of the Lord no one escaped or survived; those whom I bore and reared my enemy has destroyed.
text_cn: 你由四方给我召来施行恐怖的人，好像过节一样；在上主发怒之日，无人能够逃脱，或者幸免；我孕育抚养的，我的仇人都杀尽灭绝。
